entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (opening entry at model_first_use_year); sibling drug allowed with product_in_model false
entries.note: DOI resolves (PMID 11053025, Am J Physiol Lung 279:L895). Quote verbatim. Non-member SB 239063, no human readout: untested opening entry is right. Species of the inhaled-LPS arm is indeed absent from the abstract.

entries.rule: evidence rule 1 (stated comparison); readout_tier direct = ex-vivo blockade of a stimulus
entries.note: DOI resolves (PMID 29549158, JPET 365:567, epub 2018-03-16). Quote verbatim in abstract; in vitro whole-blood pIC50u 8.7 vs ex vivo 8.8 supports within_2x. Abstract reports rat PK only, no rat LPS model, so the separate track is consistent.

entries.rule: untested = model existed, no admissible comparison
entries.note: DOI resolves (PMID 16953188, PMC1978438). Quote verbatim. Macrophages from smokers/emphysema patients with non-member SB239063/SD-282; Patel 2018 full text confirms no sputum biomarkers were collected in the COPD trial, so untested holds.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (opening entry)
entries.note: Quote verbatim in Hope 2009 abstract. Opens the track; the projected human exposure is only in the paywalled full text, so an untested opening entry is correct.

entries.rule: dose table row 'reached, drug worked'
entries.note: Quote verbatim in MacNee 2013 abstract (PMID 23539534, epub 2013-03-28). 'Same' follows the table, but no source read states the model's projected exposure or that 3-6 mg reached it; inferred from the dose range. Paywalled full texts not opened.

entries.rule: dose table row 'reached, failed, abandoned' with derived_from efficacy; healthy-volunteer PK counts
entries.note: Patel 2018 full text (PMC5877500): quote verbatim in Discussion; challenge dose 1,200 ug lung-deposited, trial 1.0 mg delivered once daily for 12 weeks, no sputum PD in patients. Target shown reached in volunteers, trial failed, program dropped.
entries.adjudication_note: Dose scored on its own prediction (rule v4): the lung PD target was shown reached in volunteers

entries.rule: untested = prediction made, no admissible comparison
entries.note: DOI resolves (PMID 26904383, PMC4759708, epub 2015-11-09). Quote verbatim. Registry confirms NCT01332097 and NCT02700919 used single or repeated single doses with no continuous-dosing arm, so the regimen prediction was never tested.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (opening entry); sibling drug allowed
entries.note: Underwood 2000 abstract: quote verbatim (final sentence). Non-member drug, inflammatory readouts only, no COPD patient result in 2000: untested opening is right.

entries.rule: same = agreement in direction for >=1 member; endpoint_role primary
entries.note: MacNee 2013 abstract: quote verbatim; paper states trough FEV1 at week 6 was the primary endpoint (registry NCT00559910 lists only generic spirometry/safety, no results). Direction-only pairing with Underwood 2000 is sound; no later knowledge used.

entries.rule: dose/efficacy table 'reached, failed, abandoned'; decision 13 (judge on data) — see rule question 1
entries.note: EudraCT record verified (11 Jul 2015): 32-60 mL, CIs exclude zero, sponsor criteria missed, drug dropped. NCT01321463 synopsis (2016-06-02) quote verified verbatim: 27 mL, C1 met 0.927, C2a 0.104. Direction agreed, so same+partial is arguable; raised as rule question.

entries.rule: contra; one drug's contra beats another's same on the track
entries.note: Patel 2018 abstract: quote verbatim. NCT02238483 results posted 2018-04-18: HR 1.39 (0.81-2.40), p 0.2371 confirmed. Pairing with Underwood 2000 at product_in_model false is consistent, since Pehrson 2018 reports rat PK only.

entries.rule: contra on the registered primary (Novartis NCT01332097); see rule question 2 for AETHER
entries.note: Strâmbu 2019 abstract (PMID 31682162, epub 2019-11-04): quote verbatim except subscript and truncation. NCT01332097 results 2023-03-21 confirmed. AETHER reading is contestable: registered primary is within-arm Day-7 change, declared met in Mereo's 2017-12-11 RNS; vs-placebo contrasts null.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (opening at model_first_use_year, proxy allowed)
entries.note: Registry record confirmed: Pfizer, first posted 2014-03-12, study 2006-09 to 2008-03, n=24, no results. Brief title quoted verbatim. Opening the human-challenge track at 2006 by proxy is within rule 6.

entries.rule: status table, contra row ('one drug's contra still beats another drug's same on the same track'); evidence rule 7 (what was known at the entry's date)
entries.note: Quote verbatim in Singh 2015 Discussion. The same drug's 12-week miss (EudraCT 11 Jul 2015) was public before epub 2015-08-13 and is scored contra on the rodent track; the same datum cannot be same here. Tracks rule question 1.
entries.adjudication_note: Evidence rule 7 and decision 6: at the 2015-08-13 epub the 12-week PH-797804 miss (EudraCT 2015-07-11) was public and contra is permanent on a track, so the track reads contra in 2015; Singh's 6-week match stays as provenance.

entries.rule: contra with comparison_stated true, source_calls_it miss
entries.note: Patel 2018 Discussion: quote verbatim; the model's own authors call the challenge a poor predictor. NCT01937338 no results; NCT02238483 results 2018-04-18; NCT02366637 termination quote verified (n=13, results 2016-07-06, -0.047 vs +0.080 L). No reversal source.

entries.rule: contra with comparison_stated true; distinct model system gets its own model_id
entries.note: Verified as two consecutive Discussion sentences in Patel 2018; Table-3 patient_trials quote also verbatim. Human-cell/rat-PK system is a different model from the volunteer challenge, so a separate track is defensible.

entries.rule: safety: silence on a harm is not a prediction; no stated margin
entries.note: Hope 2009 abstract: quote verbatim, no toxicology or margin stated. NCT01321463 synopsis confirms drug-related AE discontinuations 13 (6.9%) vs 5 (2.7%). Untested holds. The EudraCT 19/182 at 6 mg figure was not re-checked.

entries.rule: safety: stated prediction held (comparison_stated true) — see rule question 3
entries.note: Pehrson 2018 abstract: quote verbatim; 0.3 nM unbound plasma below pIC50u held in volunteers, SAEs balanced in Patel 2018. An exposure claim rather than a named harm; whether it belongs in safety or dose is a rule question.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 / decision 7 (opening entry at model_first_use_year, proxy allowed); decision 8 (distinct system, own model_id)
entries.note: PMC7825188 full text: quote verbatim in Introduction (hyphens normalised). Model verified on MBCT102 (completed 2016-10) and applied before MBCT103 began 2018-03-19, so the 2017 proxy holds. Distinct from the De Buck 2015 tolerance model.

entries.rule: dose: exposure prediction held in healthy volunteers (subjects recorded); decision 16 (margin_stated); decision 11 (magnitude, partial agreement)
entries.note: Quote verbatim in Discussion. Table 3 confirms predicted AUC GMR 1.31/1.69 and Cmax 1.03/1.04 vs observed 1.10/0.99: within_2x holds; model applied prospectively (MBCT103 run 2018-03-19 to 2018-05-11). Source also says the predicted AUC CI fell outside 80-125%, so source_calls_it 'partial' fits better than 'match'; status unchanged.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (opening entry, untested); decision 8 (own model_id)
entries.note: DOI resolves to J Med Microbiol 67:452 (PMID 29458547); quote verbatim in the abstract and on the journal page (received 2017-08-18, accepted 2018-01-10, online 2018-01-24). Full text paywalled; experiments undated. Opening at the 2018 public first use is within rule 7.

entries.rule: decision 10 (retro = a model result that post-dates and is motivated by the patient result); drafter brief: built or run after the clinic knew
entries.note: Strambu 2019 abstract: quote verbatim, no infection-AE data, so the pairing is thin. Growcott was received 2017-08-18, four years after NCT01332097 completed (2013-05), but the run date is unstated and the abstract's stated motivation is viral replication, not the trial. Retro is the conservative reading; 'same' if the run preceded 2013. Not decidable from the sources; rule question added.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (opening entry); sibling drug allowed with product_in_model false; decision 8 (distinct from rodent LPS)
entries.note: DOI resolves (JPET 324:921, PMID 18056868, epub 2007-12-04). Quote verbatim as the abstract's last sentence (PubMed renders 'p38alpha'). Scios SD-282 only, no member drug, no patient result in 2007: untested opening at 2007 is right.

entries.rule: same = agreement in direction for >=1 member; paired comparison with model_src (comparison_stated false); endpoint_role primary
entries.note: MacNee 2013 abstract (epub 2013-03-28): quote verbatim including the '0·166' middle dot; primary endpoint trough FEV1 at week 6 stated. NCT00559910 (Pfizer, 2008-2009, n=230) has no posted results. Direction-only pairing mirrors the confirmed rodent-LPS entry on the same trial; no source states the smoke-model comparison, so the track stays hatched.

entries.rule: dose/efficacy table 'reached, failed, abandoned'; one drug's contra beats another's same on the track; inherits rule question 1
entries.note: EudraCT 2011-005864-11 re-read via fc.py: first version 11 Jul 2015, Pfizer A6631033, NCT01543919; quote verbatim in the end-point footnote. Contra at 2015 is consistent with the adjudicated efficacy 7 and the rodent-LPS efficacy 3; same+partial stays the open alternative under rule question 1.

missing: Armstrong 2011, doi:10.1124/jpet.111.180737 (JPET 338:732, PMID 21610141): COPD-patient alveolar macrophages ex vivo; non-member sibling BIRB-796 synergises with dexamethasone on LPS-induced cytokines, predicting add-on benefit of a p38 inhibitor over a corticosteroid. Tested by PH-797804 6 mg on salmeterol/fluticasone background (NCT01321463; EudraCT 2010-024219-15 Public Disclosure Synopsis published 2016-06-02: 27 mL, C1 met at 0.927, C2a missed at 0.104). The draft's copd-ex-vivo-alveolar-macrophages track has no efficacy entry; this pairing gives it one (class level, product_in_model false, comparison_stated false, year 2016).

Mereo BioPharma RNS 2017-12-11 'Positive results from Phase 2 trial with BCT-197' (https://www.lse.co.uk/rns/positive-results-from-phase-2-trial-with-bct-197-xivpowfecz8pva2.html; also mereobiopharma.com news): tier-5 source declaring AETHER's registered within-arm Day-7 FEV1 primary met (p=0.012 high dose, p<=0.001 low dose; placebo p=0.102) three years before the registry posting of 2020-11-30. The draft's note reads AETHER as a miss on the vs-placebo contrasts (+27/+58 mL, p 0.51/0.15, confirmed on NCT02700919) without showing this; it should be listed with trial_unreported handling and the rule question below.

Yu 2022, doi:10.3389/fphar.2022.950035 (Front Pharmacol, PMC9554617): tier-4 meta-analysis of 10 p38-inhibitor COPD RCTs (n=1,751) finding no efficacy or safety difference versus placebo. It pools non-members (losmapimod) so it cannot set a member-only status, but it is a patient-side record the draft should cite with that caveat.

Millan 2011, doi:10.1021/jm200677b (J Med Chem, PMID 21888439): PF-03715455 design paper states 'efficacy and safety profiles confirming its potential as an inhaled agent'. If it carries a rodent LPS result for this member, the rodent-lps-lung-neutrophilia track should record product_in_model true for PF-03715455. Abstract-level only; the model data were not verified.
rule_questions: A primary endpoint that is statistically positive in direction (PH-797804 12-week trough FEV1 +32 to +60 mL on tiotropium, 95% CIs excluding zero; +27 mL on ICS/LABA with C1 met) but below the sponsor's pre-specified decision bar (>=50 mL at >0.50 posterior probability) and below MCID, after which the drug was dropped: is that 'reached, failed, abandoned' -> contra, or 'same' with source_calls_it partial? Decision 13 says judge on data, but names no bar for a direction-only model. The answer decides efficacy entries 3 and 7 and dose entry 3.

When the registered primary endpoint is a within-arm change from baseline with no placebo contrast (AETHER NCT02700919: declared met by the sponsor, p=0.012/<0.001 within arm; vs-placebo +27/+58 mL, p=0.51/0.15), does the atlas score the registered primary as met or the placebo-corrected effect as null?

A model statement that systemic exposure will be sub-pharmacological (Pehrson 2018, AZD7624) is an exposure claim, not a named harm. Does it score in safety as the draft does, as a dose margin (margin_stated), or not at all?

When a source states a comparison with one trial (Singh 2015 -> 6-week PH-797804 win) while a higher-tier record of a later trial of the same drug on the same track was already public at the entry date (12-week miss, 11 Jul 2015), does rule 7 require the entry's status to reflect the whole record as of that date, or does the stated comparison stand with the miss as a separate same-year entry?

A sponsor-authored model paper (Growcott 2018, all-Novartis authors, received 2017-08-18) appeared after the sponsor's own trial completed (NCT01332097, 2013-05) but before any public patient record (Strambu 2019 epub 2019-11-04; registry 2023-03-21), and neither dates its experiments nor cites the trial result as motivation. Does decision 10 date a retrodiction by the sponsor's private knowledge (retro, as drafted) or by the public record (same), and who carries the burden when the run date is unknown? Decides safety entry 4 of bct197-mouse-influenza-infection.
